subject: one-metre-square section of a house wall of rough stone, on its own: rough fieldstones of mixed middling sizes laid in rough, broken courses, one metre long, one metre tall and half a metre thick, the thickness plain at its ends, seen at a three-quarter view; its two ends, its top and its bottom cut flat and square so sections stack and butt edge to edge; the same rough grey fieldstone, ochre staining, lichen and pale lime mortar as the reference wall, its stones irregular and rough-faced, never neat bricks, the mortar recessed a little between them
